## Digital engagement for research, culture, and the ocean

I'm Kiki 👋 

I work at the intersection of digital scholarship, cultural heritage, and ocean sustainability, with a particular interest in how digital technologies shape access to research, collections, and knowledge.

I work in [Digital Scholarship](https://library.soton.ac.uk/digital-scholarship) at the University of Southampton, and manage digital engagement for the [Ocean Decade Heritage Network](https://www.oceandecadeheritage.org/), supporting efforts to better integrate cultural heritage into ocean sciences within the framework of the [UN Ocean Decade](https://oceandecade.org/). Alongside this, I offer freelance consultancy.

Here you'll find my writing, publications, and projects exploring the connections between research, culture, and the sea.
